senses.sense_definition: Чувствовать обиду, принимать что-либо за обиду, испытывать чувство огорчения от несправедливого отношения.

examples.text: Пожалуйста, не надо <w>обижаться</w> на мои слова, я не хотел тебя задеть.

target_lang_translations.en: Please don't <w>take offense</w> at my words, I didn't mean to hurt you.

examples.text: Она часто привыкла <w>обижаться</w> по пустякам, поэтому с ней трудно общаться.

target_lang_translations.en: She often tends to <w>get offended</w> over trifles, which makes her difficult to communicate with.

target_lang_definitions.en: To feel offended, hurt, or upset by someone's words or actions, especially due to perceived unfairness.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to feel resentful or hurt by someone's actions or words
to choose to feel insulted or hurt by something
to experience emotional pain or sadness from someone's behavior
to be silent and bad-tempered out of annoyance or disappointment

examples.text: Слабые ученики в этой школе часто <w>обижаются</w> старшеклассниками.

target_lang_translations.en: Weak students in this school are often <w>mistreated</w> by high schoolers.

examples.text: Никто не любит, когда маленькие дети <w>обижаются</w> взрослыми.

target_lang_translations.en: Nobody likes it when young children are <w>offended</w> by adults.

target_lang_definitions.en: Passive voice of the verb 'to offend' or 'to mistreat'; to be offended, hurt, or bullied by someone.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to be treated badly or insulted by someone
to be treated poorly or unfairly by others
